objects.description: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) has used IronPython scripts as part of the [IronNetInjector](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0581) toolchain to drop payloads.(Citation: Unit 42 IronNetInjector February 2021 )
objects.description_fa: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) از اسکریپت‌های IronPython به عنوان بخشی از زنجیره ابزار [IronNetInjector](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0581) برای رها کردن بارها استفاده کرده است.(Citation: Unit 42 IronNetInjector February 2021 )
